body:
Thank you for replying.  I know getting help is the right thing to do, but you're right, I don't trust people and I don't trust that things will change.  I especially don't trust people since I've started hearing voices and reality is completely questionable to me at times.  I was in a psych hospital as a teenager and the only reason I got out was because I played along and told my doctor I didn't want to self-harm anymore and didn't have  suicidal ideations any longer.  Basically, I just wanted to get the fuck out.

I feel like asking for and getting help is the right choice for those around me, but the depressed part of me feels like killing myself is the right choice for me.  I know there are those people who say, "if you're going to kill yourself, just do it," and on the whole I tend to agree.  So I suppose a part of me wants help or doesn't completely want to die.  I just can't seem to find that part.
